title: This is where all your trash goes!
description:
Get a behind-the-scenes look at what happens to your curbside trash, recycling and organic waste! ♻️ 

Join us Saturday, June 13, from 8 a.m. to noon for the Miramar Greenery Open House, a free, family-friendly event. Enjoy hands-on activities, tours of Landfill and Greenery operations, grab compost & mulch, and meet our recycling mascot, Bonita Blue Bin. 

📢 What to Know Before You Go:  
The Miramar Greenery is on Convoy Street, north of Highway 52. 

All ages are welcome (participants under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian). 

Registration is not required but is helpful.  

All tour participants must sign a safety waiver before boarding the bus tour. 

A cover or tarp for any truck bed is required if loading compost/mulch.   

If vehicles are carrying any waste or items for disposal, standard Landfill fees apply. 

For details, directions, requirements and more, visit sandiego.gov/miramargreeneryopenhouse.
